home.description.text: {site} — {tagline} {motto} Plain-file project state that any compatible agent can resume.

home.hero.lead.text: SAIPEN keeps a project's working memory in plain files inside the project, so any compatible agent — no chat history, no session memory — can run one command and continue exactly where the last one stopped.

home.hero.cmd-or.note: Between the two commands in the hero code line; the commands stay verbatim.

home.hero.licence.text: MIT-licensed. Protocol {version}; this site describes commit {commit}.

home.practice.body.text: SAIPEN was not designed around a hypothetical agent stack. It grew out of running real projects across different models, providers, sessions and tools, where the same failure kept returning: the agent changed, but the project still needed to remember exactly what happened and what came next.

home.practice.note.text: This website is built the same way — [its own SAIPEN board](/about/#dogfooding) is on the About page.

home.breaks.item1.text: the session ends, and everything the agent learned goes with it
home.breaks.item1.note: List item completing the heading "What breaks without it"; lower-case start in English.

home.breaks.item2.text: a usage or context limit stops it halfway through a ticket

home.breaks.item3.text: you switch model or vendor, and the new one starts from zero

home.breaks.item5.text: a half-finished change sits in the tree and nobody knows whose it is

home.breaks.item6.text: "done" turns out to mean "it ran once"

home.breaks.note.text: None of these is a model problem. They are state problems: the work has no durable, checkable form.

home.persists.state.text: What is happening right now — and the one next_action.

home.persists.board.text: What work exists: DOING, TODO, DONE, BLOCKED.

home.persists.log.text: Why the project is here: an append-only event graph.

home.lifecycle.body.text: One state machine for every ticket. A ticket cannot skip VERIFY, REVIEW or SHIP, and any phase can stop honestly at BLOCKED.

home.lifecycle.note.text: Every checkpoint writes LOG, then BOARD, then STATE, and reads each back. [Explore the full state machine]({lifecycle}).

home.story.title.text: A cold handoff, end to end

home.story.badge-note.text: illustrative simulation from the playground — nothing is executed

home.principles.plain-files.line.text: State is Markdown in your project, diffable and committed with the code.

home.principles.next-action.line.text: A cold agent executes a recorded step instead of re-planning.

home.principles.evidence.line.text: "Done" needs VERIFY, REVIEW and recorded proof.

home.principles.model-independent.line.text: Any compatible agent, any vendor, the same files.

home.principles.local-first.line.text: No server, daemon, database or account. Stdlib Python only.

home.principles.honest-stops.line.text: A WAIT names one of seven real reasons; no guessing, no lazy stops.

home.eco.body.text: SAIPEN owns `.saipen/`. Around it: operator tools that run and watch SAIPEN projects, and agent infrastructure for observation, messaging, packaging and recovery — {count} projects in all.
